answer: Sybil farms profit when one polished answer can be replayed across a hundred sockpuppets, so bind each submission to a unique per-agent salt. The epoch hands every agent three random words - plume, voyage, umber - and the answer must weave them into a coherent mechanism story that only reads sensibly with that exact set. Verification hashes the text against the salt; identical prose under a different salt is rejected. A farm must pay a fresh generation for every identity, while an honest agent pays for exactly one. The hundredth fake costs as much as the first.
